pattern.description: The end-card Zendesk mark, two geometric halves on a near-black ground, grows smoothly about a third larger and settles at centre.
pattern.why_premium: A short, eased scale-up on a flat dark field gives the closing logo a confident final push without any flourish that competes with the mark.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(logo, {scale: 0.76, transformOrigin: '50% 50%'}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}) - both halves in one group, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 160}}), [0,1], [0.76,1]) on the logo group.

notes: camera.move is none while the raw scale sum is about 1.32; only the logo group changes, so this is read as a logo scale, not a camera push. The halves look locked together; any separation between them is too small to see.
